# Audio Lore Chapter 8 — Xiumi and the Glorious Alliance

**Narrative script for TTS generation.**

---

Xiumi and the Glorious Alliance. Twelve years old. That was how old she was when the universe asked her to save it.

The Glorious Alliance was a refugee arcology ship — one of hundreds launched during the Final Push, the last desperate act of the rebel coalition in the Last Great War. It carried forty thousand souls: humans, elves, dwarves, beastfolk, demons, all the species who had fought together against the Hybrian Shadows for three million years. They had escaped the galaxy. They had outrun the Shadow fleet. But they had not outrun the sabotage.

The Shadows had planted agents aboard before launch. In the eighth month of the voyage, the ship's reactor began to destabilize. The engineers could not reach it — the access corridor had been sealed. The only way in was through the ventilation system. Too narrow for an adult. Too tight for anyone larger than a child.

Xiumi volunteered.

She crawled through the vents for eight days. No light. No food except what she could carry. The ducts were cold metal and she could hear the reactor groaning below her, a wounded beast trying to die. On the eighth day she reached the reactor control panel. She pressed the button.

But the sabotage was deeper than anyone knew. The reactor did not stabilize — it ruptured.

The explosion tore Xiumi's soul into three fragments. One stayed with her body. One drifted into the cosmos. One was scattered across the ship.

The Glorious Alliance crashed into Ge'or's moon, shattering it into the ring known as the Silver Bride. The ship itself plunged into the Formingar Ocean. Xiumi's body was never found.

Her soul fragments, however, endured. One would become Nethra, the founder of the Ironcloak. One would drift for eight thousand years before finding a new vessel. One would become something no one could have predicted — the seed of the two protagonists of 597 AGD.

The twelve-year-old girl who crawled through the dark for eight days to press a button — she is the reason Ge'or exists. Every nation, every war, every species on the planet traces back to that moment. She did not save the ship. She saved everything that came after.

Age 1 — the Age of Nomadism — begins with her sacrifice.
